Downstream build `b6deac23bca791185783e589838b2f562774da1d`. Windows desktop executable and macOS DMG / update ZIP.

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed an issue where conversation context was not preserved when starting a print-mode (`-p`) session from an interactive message.

### Install

Download from [usemagpie.ai](https://usemagpie.ai), or `curl -fsSL https://usemagpie.ai/install.sh | sh`. An installed magpie updates itself.

- **macOS (Apple Silicon):** `magpie-darwin-arm64.dmg`
- **macOS (Intel):** `magpie-darwin-amd64.dmg`
- **Windows:** `magpie-windows-amd64.exe` (ARM: `magpie-windows-arm64.exe`)
- **Linux:** `magpie-linux-amd64` / `magpie-linux-arm64` (needs GTK 3 and WebKitGTK 4.1)
- **Terminal only:** `magpie-cli-<os>-<arch>`

Thanks to lshen1120, whose reports and code went into this release. Everyone who helped: [contributors](https://usemagpie.ai/docs/contributors).
